metadata.dataset: Wikidata bounded sample - higher-education institutions located in India
metadata.purpose: Feasibility evidence for a demoable, clearly labelled public institution directory in Pacio. NOT an import payload.

licence.applies_to: structured data in the main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces (i.e. the item statements returned here)
licence.primary_quote: All structured data (i.e. the main, Property, Lexeme, and EntitySchema namespaces) is released into the public domain under Creative Commons Zero.
licence.secondary_quote: Wikidata offers a wide range of general data about everything under the sun. All that data is licensed CC0, "No rights reserved", for the public domain.
licence.attribution_request: We offer the data in Wikidata freely and with no requirement for attribution under CC-0. In return, we would greatly appreciate it if, in your project, you mention Wikidata as the origin of your data.
licence.software_licence_note: CC0 covers the data only. The Wikibase software that serves it is GPL-2.0 (COPYING in wikimedia/mediawiki-extensions-Wikibase); Wikidata prose pages are CC BY-SA.

selection.population_definition: Items with P17 (country) = Q668 (India) that are instance of, or instance of a subclass of, one of the four target classes.
selection.class_note: Q11076398 ('Institute of technology') was tested and excluded: it has no P31 and its P17 is Taiwan, so it behaves like a specific institution, not a class. 'Engineering college' has no Wikidata item of its own; Q1663017 'engineering school' is the nearest class.
selection.sampling_method: Deterministic pseudo-random: every QID in the union was hashed with MD5 and the list sorted ascending by hex digest; first 300 taken. Reproducible, unbiased with respect to item quality.
selection.sampling_frame_caveat: The frame is the P17=India union. Institutions that carry only P131 (located in) and no P17 were not counted and cannot appear in the sample.

queries.per_class: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P17 wd:Q668 . ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:<CLASS> }
queries.count: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) AS ?n) WHERE { ?item wdt:P17 wd:Q668 . ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:<CLASS> }
queries.fields: MediaWiki wbgetentities (props=labels|claims|descriptions), followed by a level-by-level walk of P131 to resolve the state name. Claim ranks: preferred and normal kept, deprecated dropped.

field_map.located_in_admin: P131 (usually city or district - granularity is NOT uniform)
field_map.admin_parent: P131 of the P131 value (one level up)
field_map.state_resolved: DERIVED: first ancestor in the P131 chain whose English label exactly matches an Indian state/UT name; null if the chain dead-ends
field_map.affiliation_P1416: P1416 affiliation. NOTE: P1142 is NOT affiliation - it is 'political ideology'
field_map.political_ideology_P1142: P1142, fetched only to demonstrate it is the wrong property (0/300 populated)
field_map.state_raw: DERIVED: the terminal ancestor reached while walking P131 (may be 'British Raj', 'India', or a district) - diagnostic only, never display
field_map.state_depth: DERIVED: number of P131 hops walked before stopping (0-5); inconsistent depth is a data-quality signal

known_limitations: No statement-level provenance: the sample cannot show whether a value came from an official registry, Wikipedia, or a bulk import.
79.3% of sampled items carry an AISHE code, which implies a bulk import from an AISHE-derived dataset; the licence chain for those rows was not audited.
P856 URLs are frequently stale; 4 of 8 spot-checked links were dead or hijacked.
State is derived by walking P131; 23 of 300 could not be resolved to a state.
P131 chain depth ranges from 0 to 5 hops; 7 of 300 terminate at a non-state entity ('British Raj' x4, 'India' x3) and 16 have no P131 at all, so state derivation is not mechanical.
